description: The James Webb Space Telescope observed HD 80606 b undergo a dramatic temperature surge during its closest approach to its star. The data revealed extreme heating and detected methane and carbon dioxide, offering a rare look at how giant exoplanet atmospheres respond to intense stellar energy.
title: JWST Watches HD 80606 bExoplanet  Heat Up by 1,100 Degrees in Hours

description: Jio Platforms will offer up to 27 crore fresh shares, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP). This would amount to 2.9 percent of the total equity base post issue.
title: Reliance's Jio Platforms Files for Record $4 Billion IPO

description: Nothing has started teasing the launch of a new Nothing product, which will arrive as the company’s first “b” series device. However, the Carl Pei-led company has neither revealed the name of the device nor the product category. Nothing currently has A series of handsets and earphones as part of its product portfolio. Hence, the upcoming device could arrive as part of either product line. The most recent addition to its handset lineup is the Nothing Phone 4a series. Separately, tipster Yogesh Brar (@heyitsyogesh) claims that CMF, the tech firm’s sub-brand, has transferred all its existing smartphone projects to Nothing, as CMF has shelved its plans to launch any new handsets this year, while also delaying the launch of CMF Phone 2 Pro’s successor.
title: Nothing Teases Launch of Mysterious New “b” Product Series in India

description: Haier expanded its smart TV portfolio with the launch of the new HQLED P7 Pro series. They offer AI-powered smart features and include a 50W 2.1-channel speaker system with an integrated subwoofer. The audio setup is supported by Dolby Atmos and Total Sonics technology. The lineup uses Haier's HQLED display technology and supports up to 93 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut coverage. It supports Dolby Vision and HDR10+.
title: Haier HQLED P7 Pro Series Smart TVs Launched in India With Dolby Atmos, 50W Speakers

description: Reliance showcased its new AI call agent that will be available to all Jio subscribers later this year on Friday, during its 49th annual general meeting (AGM). Reliance Jio’s new voice-based AI agent is positioned as an always-available smart companion that will assist Jio subscribers when they are on a call. The company says that it is a digital concierge, which will be available “on every call”. Reliance says that Jio’s AI call agent is capable of transcribing calls. On top of this, the company claims that it will be able to identify up to 10 unique speakers during a conference call. Also, if a user finds a few members missing from an ongoing conference call, users can simply ask the AI agent to add the missing members by stating their names. The AI agent will then call others for the user, asking them to join the ongoing call.
title: Jio AI Call Agent Explained: What It Is, How It Works, Features and More

description: WhatsApp is said to be adding a redesign to how online status is displayed in the app. In the latest WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.24.5, the company replaced the 'online' label from the chat info screen with a green dot displayed directly on a contact's profile photo. Additionally, WhatsApp is said to be developing a dedicated in-app backup management section that will allow users to view, delete, and organise previous backups to free up storage space.
title: WhatsApp Begins Testing Online Indicator, New Feature to Manage Chat Backups on Android

description: Rockstar Games has updated the official GTA 6 website after revealing the pre-order date and cover art for the game. The updated website now shows a brif clip of the Vice City skyline at night. Additionally, all references of GTA 6 release date have been removed from the website.
title: Rockstar Games Shares New Look at Vice City on GTA 6 Website, Removes Release Date Mentions

description: The United Arab Emirates is said to have introduced a minimum age requirement of 15 years for social media use. Following the move, it has become the first Arab country to impose such a restriction, a report suggests. The new rules were reportedly approved under a government resolution, prohibiting children under 15 from creating, operating, or using personal social media accounts. Consequently, social media apps operating in the region will be required to impose stricter age-verification mechanisms.
title: UAE Reportedly Cracks Down on Social Media Use for Children Under 15, Mandates Age Verification

description: Redmi Turbo 5 is now available for purchase in India starting at Rs. 37,999. The smartphone is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset and offers up to 12GB of LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. It features a 6.59-inch 1.5K AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50-megapixel Sony IMX882 primary camera, and a 7,540mAh battery with 100W HyperCharge support. Buyers can also avail of a Rs. 2,000 instant bank discount.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 With 50-Megapixel Rear Camera, Dimensity 8500 Ultra Chip Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Instagram has introduced a new Multiple Captions on a Carousel feature that lets users add separate captions to individual photos and videos within a carousel post. Previously, creators could only use a single caption for an entire carousel. The feature can be enabled while creating a carousel by turning on the Multiple Captions option in the caption field. According to Instagram, the update is intended to make information easier to present alongside specific slides. The feature has started rolling out and is available in India.
title: Instagram Rolls Out Support for Multiple Captions on Carousel Posts

description: Security researchers have published the proof-of-concept exploit, dubbed "usbliter8", which targets a vulnerability in Apple's BootROM, the unalterable code that runs before iOS starts loading. Since BootROM is permanently etched into a chip during the manufacturing process, researchers said that vulnerabilities discovered at this level cannot be fixed through software updates. The newly disclosed exploit is said to affect devices ranging from the iPhone XS lineup to the iPhone 11 series, along with several iPad models powered by the A12 and A13 SoCs.
title: Unpatchable Hardware Vulnerability Leaves Owners of Older iPhone XS, iPhone XR and iPhone 11 Models at Risk

description: Malta’s financial regulator has launched a consultation on a potential legal framework for decentralised finance under the EU’s MiCA regulation. The proposal explores recognising DAOs and other DeFi projects as software-based organisations while seeking industry feedback on how decentralised services should be treated within existing regulatory structures. The consultation remains open until July 10 and forms part of broader efforts to address regulatory gaps surrounding decentralised financial applications.
title: Malta Seeks to Bring DAOs Under New DeFi Rules Aligned With MiCA

description: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G will be launched soon, the South Korean smartphone maker revealed on Friday. As part of the launch teaser, a dedicated microsite on Amazon for the upcoming Galaxy M series handset is now live in the country, confirming that the Samsung Galaxy M47 5G will be available for purchase in India via the e-commerce platform. The microsite also teases the design of the handset, which is shown to feature a pill-shaped triple rear camera module, which appears similar to the Galaxy A57. Moreover, the Galaxy M47 5G will boast a triple rear camera unit, along with an LED flash.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G India Launch Teased,  Microsite on Amazon Hints at Design

description: Apple has announced iOS 26.5 changes in Brazil that will allow alternative app marketplaces and third-party payment options on iPhones following an agreement with regulator CADE. The company will require app notarisation and marketplace authorisation as part of new security measures. Apple has also introduced revised commissions for developers using alternative distribution and payment methods. Epic Games and the Coalition for App Fairness criticised the framework, arguing that the fees and reporting requirements continue to discourage competition in the mobile app ecosystem.
title: Apple Announces App Store Changes, Support for Sideloading iOS Apps in Brazil; Epic Games Criticizes New Terms

description: Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) announced several AI-powered initiatives for its media and entertainment business at the 49th Annual General Meeting (AGM) on Friday. The company outlined new features for JioHotstar, including JioStar GenAI Media Studio (JAMS), which is designed to streamline the content creation process. AI Snapshot, Content Commerce, and Multiview were also announced, with the aim of transforming how users discover, consume, and interact with content.
title: RIL AGM 2026: JioHotstar Gets GenAI Media Studio, AI Snapshot and Content Commerce Features

description: Reliance showcased its latest AI innovations that will be launched soon in India during its 49th annual general meeting (AGM) with shareholders. RIL showcased its five new AI-backed apps for India, which will ship with support for 22 Indian languages. The list of apps includes JioBharat IQ, AI Vyapar, JioHealth IQ, JioLearn IQ, and JioKrishi IQ. The company says that these services will be available to all Jio customers. On top of this, the company has also revealed that it is integrating AI directly into the Jio network to bring an AI-powered agent, which can be triggered with a voice command during calls.
title: RIL AGM 2026: Jio Showcases AI Voice Agent for Calls, Jio TeleFrame AI Agents and JioBharat IQ Apps

description: Per Aspera Ad Astra is a sci-fi thriller about virtual reality, hidden secrets, and survival, now streaming on Netflix.
title: Per Aspera Ad Astra Out on OTT: Where to Watch the Sci-Fi Thriller Online?

description: Tecno has officially teased the arrival of the upcoming Tecno Camon Slim through new posts on X and Instagram. A teaser video shared by the company features a three-day countdown, indicating that the launch event is scheduled for June 21. It could come with a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset alongside 8GB RAM.
title: Tecno Camon Slim Confirmed to Launch Soon; Design, Colour Options Teased

description: The OnePlus Pad 3 Pro was launched in China as the company’s latest flagship tablet. It succeeds 2025’s OnePlus Pad 2 Pro and is based on the OnePlus Pad 4, which was launched in India and the global markets this year. The tablet sports a 13.2-inch LCD screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, coupled with 16GB of RAM. The OnePlus Pad 3 Pro packs a 13,380mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Pad 3 Pro Launched in China With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, 144Hz Display: Price, Specifications

description: Ultrahuman has launched M2 Live in the US with support for Abbott's over-the-counter Lingo continuous glucose monitor. Priced at $129 (roughly Rs. 12,200) for a single sensor and $99 (roughly Rs. 9,400) per month on subscription, the platform offers real-time glucose tracking, a clinically validated Metabolic Score, and Jade AI-powered insights. It also supports glucose spike alerts, Food Score and Fueling Score tools, OGDb access, and integration with data from the Ultrahuman Ring and Blood Vision services.
title: Ultrahuman Launches M2 Live Platform for Metabolic Health Monitoring: Price, Features

description: MSI has confirmed that its new high-end Claw 8 EX AI+ handheld will cost $1,800 in the US. The company said it tried its best to keep the price as low as possible in the current hardware climate, where rising component prices have led to price hikes for gaming hardware.
title: 'Tough Year for Gamers': MSI Confirms $1,800 Price Tag for New Claw 8 EX AI+ Handheld

description: Microsoft has started testing a new update for the Windows Search tool in the Start menu, the tech giant’s Partner Director of Design for Windows, March Rogers, recently announced. Now, the company executive has revealed that the update will let users completely stop web results from appearing in the Windows Search. The toggle will be added to the Privacy & Security menu in the Settings app. The improved Windows Search version is currently in the testing phase and being rolled out as part of a pre-release Windows 11 Insider Build.
title: Microsoft Starts Testing New Windows Search Update That Lets Users Disable Web Results

title: New OTT Releases of the Week (June 15 - June 21): Drishyam 3, Thukra ke Mera Pyar S2, Save The Tigers 3, Aliya Basu Gayab Hai, and More

description: iPhone Ultra is expected to go official later this year. Now a new leak has offered a detailed look at Apple's rumoured foldable iPhone. The video includes 3D renders and is likely to be available in black and white colour options and feature a passport-style book-fold design. The foldable is said to be wider than many existing foldable smartphones. The iPhone Ultra could carry a price tag of over $2,000 in the United States.
title: iPhone Ultra Leak Reveals Crease-Free Foldable Display, Slim 4.5mm Profile; Price Tipped

description: Maiin Haan is a Punjabi horror film inspired by true events, now streaming on the Chaupal App.
title: Maiin Haan Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch the Punjabi Horror Movie Inspired by Real Events

description: The Delhi High Court on Friday rejected Telegram's plea that challenged the Centre's earlier decision to temporarily block access to the messaging platform ahead of the NEET 2026 re-examination. According to a report, the week-long restriction is imposed until 2022 and was ordered by the government to curb the circulation of leaked examination material before the medical entrance test takes place on June 21. The court is said to have upheld the blocking order under Section 69A of the Information Technology Act.
title: Delhi High Court Reportedly Backs Pre-NEET Telegram Ban, Rejects Platform’s Appeal

description: Elona Holmes is finally arriving soon with its third season, only on Netflix. This time, the stakes will be higher as she embarks on her deadliest and most dangerous adventure in Malta.
title: Enola Holmes Season 3 OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Millie Bobby Brown Starrer Series Online?

description: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 on Friday as investors weighed uncertainty surrounding the US-Iran peace process alongside the Federal Reserve’s hawkish policy outlook. Analysts said mixed ETF flows, leveraged liquidations, and cautious institutional participation continued to limit bullish momentum. Market participants are closely monitoring key support and resistance levels as they assess the next direction for crypto assets.
title: Bitcoin Price Slides to $62,700 as Investors Remain Cautious Amid Ongoing Geopolitical Uncertainty

description: CMF has delayed the launch of the CMF Phone 2 Pro successor, Nothing India’s Co-Founder and President, Akis Evangelidis, announced in a post on X on Friday. The company has also shelved the plans to launch new smartphones this year because of the ongoing RAM shortage. This comes as the smartphone industry as a whole is feeling the pinch from the ever-rising manufacturing costs and prices of DRAM sticks, due to an ongoing memory and storage component shortage. While the company will not launch new CMF Phone models this year, Evangelidis did reveal that it does plan to launch new products in 2026, while also entering new product categories soon. However, the company executive did not provide further details on these devices.
title: CMF Won't Launch New Phones in 2026, CMF Phone 2 Pro Successor Delayed Due to Ongoing RAM Shortage

description: An Apple contract gives Intel a steady demand from one of the world's largest consumer electronics companies, boosting both its reputation and a manufacturing business that has lagged TSMC in recent years.
title: Trump Says Apple to Partner With Intel on US Chip Design, Production

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G design leaked again in official-looking renders. The unannounced phone is shown in Pink, Navy Blue, and Graphite Black finishes. It could come with a 5,000mAh battery and new AI features. One of the leaked images shows that the phone will offer Google's Circle to Search functionality. The Galaxy A27 5G is rumoured to come with a 6.7-inch AMOLED display and a Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Renders Leaked Again; Tipped to Feature 5,000mAh Battery

description: Athiradi is a Malayalam action comedy that blends college life, revenge, and suspense, now streaming on Sony LIV.
title: Athiradi Now Available for Streaming on OTT: Where to Watch the Malayalam Action Comedy Online

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series, the rumoured successor to this year’s Galaxy S26 lineup, is expected to be launched in select global markets, including India, early next year. During an internal briefing, Samsung’s President of System LSI Business, Park Yong-In, reportedly confirmed that the tech giant has kicked off the development of its next-generation mobile platform, namely Exynos 2700, which is expected to feature on next year’s Galaxy S27 lineup. The chipset will succeed the Exynos 2600 SoC, which was released last year and powers the Samsung Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+.
title: Samsung Executive Reportedly Confirms Exynos 2700 Development for Upcoming Flagship Phones

description: Hisense has launched the E8S 144Hz ULED Mini-LED TV series in India, starting at Rs. 57,990. Available in 55-inch, 65-inch, 75-inch, and 85-inch sizes, the lineup features ULED Mini-LED panels with Full Array Local Dimming, a native 144Hz refresh rate, and Hi-QLED Colour technology. The TVs support HDR10+ Adaptive, Dolby Vision IQ, Filmmaker Mode, and run on VIDAA Smart OS. They are powered by the Hi-View AI Engine and feature a Devialet-tuned built-in subwoofer for enhanced audio.
title: Hisense E8S 144Hz ULED Mini-LED TV Series With Dolby Vision IQ Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series could launch early next year, but early rumours are starting to paint a picture of what to expect from the base Galaxy S27 model. The company reportedly will not upgrade the base Galaxy S27’s cameras or display. This suggests that the new phone will use the same camera sensors as the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S25. The Galaxy S26 has a triple rear camera setup, including a 50-megapixel primary wide-angle sensor.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 to Miss Out on Major Display and Camera Upgrades: Report

description: Qualcomm is betting on a connected AI ecosystem powered by Snapdragon chips across multiple categories, enabling seamless experiences through distributed AI and agentic workflows.
title: Qualcomm Doesn't Want AI to Live on Your Phone, It Wants AI to Follow You Everywhere

description: iQOO is rumoured to be expanding the iQOO Z11 lineup in China. Following the arrival of iQOO Z11, Z11x, and Z11 Turbo earlier this year, the company has now begun teasing the iQOO Z11i. Although the brand has yet to reveal its launch date, the upcoming handset has already been listed for pre-order on iQOO's online store. Further, the design and colour options of the iQOO Z11i have been teased through social media.
title: iQOO Z11i Design, Colour Options Revealed Ahead of Anticipated Launch in China

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series is scheduled to be launched in select global markets next month. While the company remains tight-lipped on its India debut, a new report suggests that the lineup in the country could include an additional model in the form of the Oppo Reno 16c. The purported handset is said to arrive as a more affordable alternative within the Reno 16 family and could share several specifications with the globally rumoured Reno 16F.
title: Oppo Reno 16c to Reportedly Launch in India Alongside Reno 16; Specifications Tipped
